newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK STUDENTS URGE MINISTER TO GO OVER STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK STUDENTS URGE MINISTER TO GO OVER STRIKE.

text.p: Some 250 students staged a demonstration outside the Slovak parliament on Thursday in support of striking actors and theatre workers and to call for Culture Minister Ivan Hudec to be sacked.
The students blocked the main road past the building as the parliamentary committee on culture was meeting to discuss a deepening crisis in the theatre.
Some 30 policemen erected barriers in front of parliament but did not intervene in the peaceful protest.

The committee meeting was called by opposition deputies who demanded Hudec explain the cause of the crisis over alleged state interference in the arts and his handling of a sit-in by actors in the ministry on Monday.
Hudec called in police to clear the ministry of the actors and their supporters, including opposition parliamentarians.
Relations between Slovakia's stage community and government have been strained since last summer when Hudec sacked the director and artistic director of the National Theatre.
Many theatres have been on strike since last month.
Hudec did not appear before the committee, opposition deputy Ivan Simko told the students. Slovak President Michal Kovac on Wednesday called on Hudec to resign.
